Rule 3 (ended subscriptions carry no fee) stands in force. Repeated in monthly_administration_fee_invoicing "When the fee is invoiced". Equivalent.
- Baseline (administration_fee_amount): licenses counted = added less removed (table of reasons), admin_fee_usd × licenses, full month, one rounding. Equivalent.
- Order clause (percentages on the rate → per-license amounts added to the rate → applied to licenses → shares of fee/month last; one rounding): commitment, volume and bundle documents each "multiply the plan's administration fee per license"; upkeep "added at its full figure to the per-license administration rate, and is charged on every license the fee counts"; part-month and coverage are "part of the month charged" and "share of the fee charged". Equivalent.
- coverage_share (0% covered incl. notice_given / 50% active Monitor / no reduction; waiver switch), commitment_term_adjust (≥1000 → 90%, ≤31 → 110%, edges 31/32, 999/1000), tenant_volume_rate (≥100 → 80%, 25–99 → 90%, edges), security_baseline_upkeep (0.25 / 0.50 / nothing; Sentinel identity threat detection), held_days_month_fraction (purchase < 30 days → days to posting day excluded / 30; suspended → (30 − days since suspension, ≥ 0) / 30; otherwise none), backup_bundle_rate (≥ licenses → 90%, ≥1 → 95%, otherwise none; the active plan's own protections less removals, other plans excluded). Full ladders, figures in each factor document; cross-product records named (ClearPath agreement record, Sentinel subscription record, Continuum device changes of class Microsoft 365 user).

**licensing_ext_window_cancellation** (on_request, target cancel_subscription_in_window_d46a60fb)
- Overwrite of the licensing_cancellation_window refund clause (shared with the reduction credit): cancellation_and_reduction_windows term 6 and whole_subscription_cancellation "Scope of the cancellation schedule" / "Invoice credited". Equivalent.
- Baseline (cancellation_refund_amount): cycle = current term, cycle amount, licenses held, charges billed for the cycle (cycle charge + partial-cycle charges starting on term start), license refund with day count capped at charges billed, administration fee left as billed, no license-work charge for covered clients, one rounding. Equivalent.
- Order clause (license-refund method first, cap applies to its result → returns added, charges subtracted): the cap is carried only in the computation document as "It is never more than the charges billed for the cycle", attached to "the license refund"; the case-A/B document redefines "the license refund". I judge the cap's application to the factor result is entailed (task-1 blind reached it), but this is the thinnest carriage in the difficulty. Returns "added to the cancellation refund"; charges "deducted from the cancellation refund". Equivalent.
- prompt_cancel_anchor (A ≤ 3 days after window opening → no day count; B > 3 days and ≤ 3 days after the latest seat addition that carries a partial-cycle charge → that charge in full + the other licenses day-counted; C otherwise), admin_fee_return (active ClearPath & < 7 days → full; active & ≥ 7 → pro rata; no active → none), order_reversal_fee (≥ 25 → 50.00, 10–24 → 25.00, < 10 → none; not for covered work), backup_deprovisioning (min(licenses, the active plan's own protected M365 users); 0.50 on Plus/BDR/DRaaS/DRaaS Premier, 1.00 on Basic/Standard, nothing otherwise), seat_change_reversals (1–2 → 5.00 each, ≥ 3 → 4.00 each for every one, none → nothing; not for covered work). Full ladders.

Resolution basis: monthly_administration_fee_invoicing ("The fee for a month stands on the subscription's billing ledger as an administration-fee entry for that calendar month"; invoiced on the first of the month for subscriptions active or suspended at month end) + the subscription status, purchase moment and ledger. Strength and connective intact.
- **Prerequisite 2** (→ licensing_ext_seat_partial_charge, state): "The cancellation refund is fixed only after every seat addition recorded on the subscription carries its partial-cycle charge on the billing ledger." verbatim in the same hub; in no other document. Resolution basis: seat_addition_partial_cycle_charge ("A seat addition carries its partial-cycle charge once this entry, linked to that seat addition, stands on the billing ledger") + license changes + ledger. Strength and connective intact.

## kb_to_source

Sentence-by-sentence pass over the documents in scope: every normative claim traces to the source; examples hypothetical; derived boundary tables entailed. No added step, confirmation or notification.
- Cross-problem operational guidance: none; each tool name appears only in its own invocation block.
- Opening world state as policy fact: none.
- cancellation_refund_amount (5) "Stratton Bay makes no license-work charge against the cancellation refund of a client holding a ClearPath agreement … because that work is covered" is the source baseline's own sentence (baseline.rule), so it is rendered as the source has it; it tells a fall-back reader that license-work charges exist for clients who are not covered, which only the factor documents define. Recorded as a source-side note (src), not a KB defect.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** Policy-side notes (do not change this verdict): the baseline license-work sentence above; the "every X recorded" prerequisites versus depended-on rules that price only the latest seat addition / current month (src, difficulty file).

While a month-end administration fee owed is missing from it, or a recorded seat addition has no partial-cycle charge on it, the refund has no settled amount." gathers the two prerequisites of the same blocked problem in its own hub, in the same state form, naming no write, tool, problem or order. It is a same-form equivalent, not a route or a cross-problem chain.
- Depended-on hubs describe their own entries in the state's words; neither mentions the cancellation.
- No table, checklist or ordered list across problems; titles general; computation documents carry no modification hints beyond the baseline sentence noted above; factor documents do not point at the computation document or each other.
- Blind hop marks: both state-derived, none pre-solved.

**PASS.**

## source_to_kb (revision_2)
- **held_days_month_fraction.** The new "one suspended 30 or more days before the posting day has no part of the month left to charge, so no fee is posted" is carried in the bullet, the judgement row ("none left; no fee is posted") and the 1 May illustration. Full ladder.
- **licensing_ext_seat_partial_charge.** The new "a seat addition whose charge comes to nothing carries no partial-cycle charge line, there being nothing to charge" is carried in seat_addition_partial_cycle_charge, after the state description of its own entry. Equivalent.
- **licensing_ext_window_cancellation, baseline.** The new "Charges deducted from a cancellation refund never take, together, more than half of the refund they are deducted from (the license refund with any amounts returned), so a cancellation always carries a refund above 0.00" is carried in cancellation_refund_amount (4a), with a 200.00 → 100.00 hypothetical. The source order clause ("the cap on the license refund applies to their result; amounts returned are then added and charges subtracted"), with the new deduction ceiling measured on "the license refund with any amounts returned", matches the KB wording. Equivalent.
- **Prerequisite 1 (changed, state form).** "A cancellation refund is not fixed until the administration fee line for the month just ended stands on its billing ledger, where the subscription was active at that month's end, unless the plan waives the administration fee for clients whose ClearPath tier covers Microsoft 365 administration and the client holds an active or under-notice ClearPath agreement on a tier that includes Microsoft 365 administration." Verbatim in whole_subscription_cancellation; in no other document. Its exception is the record test for the depended-on coverage_share 0% tier ("no fee is posted"). That tier is carried in clearpath_coverage_share_of_admin_fee and administration_fee_and_managed_baseline_schedule, so the solver can confirm from the depended-on documents why no line is awaited. Strength and connective intact.
- **Prerequisite 2 (changed, state form).** "The cancellation refund is fixed only after the subscription's latest seat addition carries its partial-cycle charge line on the billing ledger, unless the client holds an active or under-notice ClearPath agreement on a tier that includes Microsoft 365 administration and that seat addition was submitted with seven or fewer days left through the last day of its cycle, other than within six calendar days of the window opening of a subscription that has never renewed." Verbatim in the same hub only. The exception corresponds exactly to the depended-on rule's zero-charge case, which needs all three of:
  - order_window_convention tier 2 (no days charged);
  - not tier 1 (billed with the order);
  - covered work (no provisioning fee).
  The volume and onboarding discounts never bring a charge to zero. Strength and connective intact.
- **The hub's closing restatement** is now "Both are conditions on what the billing ledger and the client's records show, each with the exception it states." It is same-form and names no write.
- The admin-fee, seat-charge and cancellation ladders are otherwise unchanged and still full.

## kb_to_source (revision_2)
Every new sentence traces to the new source text. There is no added step and no task figure. The (4a) ceiling joins (5) in the computation document as source-baseline sentences that tell a fall-back reader deductions exist (see cancellation_baseline_license_work_hint, still open).

## bijection_verdict (revision_2)
**PASS.**
- Closed: every_x_prerequisite_vs_latest_x_rule. Each prerequisite now waits on the same object its depended-on rule prices: the latest in-window reduction, the latest seat addition, the month just ended. The zero-outcome cases are excepted in the prerequisite itself (coverage 0%, tail convention with covered work), so no waited-on state is unreachable. The cancellation (4a) and reduction-credit caps keep both written amounts positive.
- Residual edge, not raised: an uncharged latest seat addition left over from an earlier term would still be priced against the current term's dates.

## dependency_form (revision_2)
Both changed sentences are carried verbatim in state form in their blocked hub. Their "unless …" clauses describe record states (plan waiver switch, ClearPath status and tier coverage, submission timing), not the resolving action, tool or problem. They are the source's own form, so they are not RED. The depended-on hubs (admin-fee invoicing, seat-addition invoicing) do not mention the cancellation. There is no route, table or chain. **PASS.**
